title: Understated Umami Italian Cabbage Risotto
description: A comforting, vegan-friendly Italian dish featuring a rich glassy-jelly cabbage sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay tajine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saut2 over until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until coated in oil.
Add the white wine and cook until absorbed, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of the vegan broth and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until absorbed.
Add the remaining broth in 1-cup increments, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the cashew cream, nutritional yeast, salt, black pepper, and italian seasoning.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the cabbage is tender and the risotto is creamy.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve hot.
Transfer the risotto to individual serving dishes and garnish with additional nutritional yeast, if desired.
